title: Simplexwise product factorization of a Kan fibration
statement: Use simplicial sets, standard simplices and horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and write $\partial\Delta^n$ for the union of the proper faces of $\Delta^n$, with $\partial\Delta^0=\varnothing$. A Kan fibration is a simplicial map lifting against every $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$, $n\geq1$, $0\leq i\leq n$. For every Kan fibration $p:X\to Y$ there are a simplicial subset $X'\subseteq X$, its inclusion $s:X'\to X$, and a retraction $r:X\to X'$ with $rs=1_{X'}$, such that $p=qr$ for $q=ps:X'\to Y$. The map $r$ has the right lifting property against every $\partial\Delta^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$, including $n=0$. The map $q$ is a Kan fibration and, for every $n\geq0$ and every simplex $y:\Delta^n\to Y$, there exist a Kan complex $F_y$ and an isomorphism $\Delta^n\times_YX'\cong\Delta^n\times F_y$ over $\Delta^n$. No Kan hypothesis is imposed on $X$ or $Y$, and $F_y$ may be empty.

ModelCategory.cm5a and FibrantBrownFactorization are general model factorizations and do not imply the stated local triviality or boundary-lifting retraction; their hypotheses also do not supply a Kan–Quillen model instance.
